identity.note: W177 hatchback, pre-facelift (2018-2022) — the generation a UK 2019 plate carries. Source car for the generated mesh: white A180 Auto SE 1.3 petrol, Motorpoint dealer studio orbit, six views. Dims are published W177 5-door hatchback figures; trim-specific values (tyre size varies SE/Sport/AMG Line) are recorded as the SE fitment. Overhangs deliberately omitted — unverified, and this project does not fabricate vehicle metadata.
